page.layout: One column of running text, full width, with Hebrew, Syriac and Latin mixed in the lines; no marginal notes; signature line at the foot.

main_text.p: שִׁקְיָא Ch. Stagna, Exo. 8.1. in Jon. Cum aff. שְׁקִיהוֹן Stagna ipsorum, Exo. 7.19. in Jon.
main_text.head: שקל
main_text.p: Syr. Tulit, sustulit, portavit, gestavit, Bajulavit. Accepit, abstulit: accepit, duxit uxorem. Hinc in Targum דְשָׁקַל מַרְטוּטָא מְחַבְּרִידָא Qui aufert vestimentum ab amico suo, Prover. 25.20. וְהוָא מְמוּכָן שְׁקַל יַתְהָא דְפַרְסִיאָתָא Et Memucham ducebat uxorem Persicam, Esth. 1.16. in Targ. sec. דִישְׁקַל Quam abstulit, Cantic. 2.15. שְׁקַלוּן וְיַתְרוּן Accipiunt & dant, h.e. negotiantur, Cant. 3.8. Ruth 4.7. Item Migrare navi, Discedere, לָא שָׁקַל Solvit ex Galilaea, Matth. 19.1. Tremel. exponit ex primo significatu. Vide ejus notas. Ethpehal ܐܬܫܩܠ Ablatus, Sublatus est.
Syr. Pondus, לֶשְׁקַל Pondere, vel moderamine judicii tui, Act. 24.3.
מִשְׁקּוֹלְתָּא, מִשְׁקָלְתָּא Chald. Pondus: perpendiculum, amusisis, Jesa. 34.11. & 44.13.
main_text.head: שקע
main_text.p: Ithpehal אִשְׁתַּקַּע. Ithpah. אִשְׁתְּקַע Submergi, interire, in profundum deprimi, profundum petere, Exod. 15.10. Deuteronom. 29.22. in Jonath. Pahel שַׁקַּע Sculpi, insculpi in profundum, in profundum, in terram figi, infigi, Esth. 9.14. & 1.2. in Targum sec. Exod. 25.33.34. & 37.19.20. Jon. &c. Submergere, demergere, tegere, occultare, Numer. 4.20. Targ. Hierof.
שְׁקוּעַ Ch. Submersio, abscondsio, Num. 4.20. in Jonat.

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Chaldee words are transcribed approximately; the Syriac letters and vowel points in the lines are doubtful. The heading words שקל and שקע are printed as large Hebrew letters.
